q1_issues.issue: 'counts of <offense>' is encoded with Possession, but the of-phrase names what the count charges (an about/content relation), which the of-phrase rules explicitly exclude from Possession — the licensed encoding is the entity-attached surface-preposition oblique (Of ...), which this same parse uses at index 20 for 'abuse of a dead body'.
Same unlicensed Possession-for-of on the second count.
Same unlicensed Possession-for-of on the third count.
Same unlicensed Possession-for-of on the fourth count.

The fused compound false_statement is emitted with no decomposition: the head genus (Inheritance false_statement statement) is always required, and 'false' is predicable of a statement so the modifier genus is required too.

q2_gaps: a gerund-headed action NP used as a bare charge name ('making false statements') — the compound-action shape (genus + Patient on the compound symbol) is specified only for an action term inside a reified (can ...) / (obligated ...) / (permitted ...) property, not for a free-standing nominal
a bare numeric appositive age ('Ray Brent Marsh, 29,') — the Measure rule needs a stated dimension, so scale 'old' and unit 'year' come entirely from world knowledge
'multiple' as a vague-quantity phrase — it is not among the listed CardinalityPhrase words, so whether it is a canonical lexicon string (and thus maps to a bound) is unspecified

a coordinated list of charges under one 'multiple counts of ...' — nothing says whether each conjunct gets its own count individual (as here, four sk_count_N witnesses) or whether the of-phrase attaches to the counts group
notes: Good: the parse asserts the charges, not guilt; the present-tense host correctly leaves the age Measure unwrapped and the stative-transitive 'faces' takes Agent + Theme with no status atom. The nominalization oblique (Of sk_abuse_1 sk_body_1) and the split 'dead body' typing are exactly right, which makes the Possession-for-of on the four counts an internal inconsistency.
